name: 再靠近一点 · 暧昧拉扯 · V2

parameters.prompt: Compose an ORIGINAL instrumental cue for a sophisticated contemporary dark-romance interactive drama, adult mutual attraction, dangerous secrets, charismatic powerful male lead. Strong emotional tension and immediately recognizable rhythm, not generic ambient wallpaper. Clear on phone speakers through mid-bass harmonics, not only sub-bass. No vocals, words, breathing, choir, spoken samples or environmental effects. Original melody and arrangement, no quotations from existing recordings. Musical sections must visibly change in energy while leaving midrange space for dialogue. 40-second scene cue. Slow-burning electro-R&B / trip-hop at82 BPM in D minor, warm rounded saturated bass riff, syncopated rim click and kick, intimate muted electric guitar with short delay and sultry bowed cello counterline. An original five-note motif returns but changes its last note as an unanswered question. First2s establish pulse. 8s add granular upper shimmer; 16s brief one-beat withdrawal then a closer thicker bass response; 24s guitar and cello intertwine, 30s expressive rising strings; 36-40s withdraw to an unresolved soft chord tail. Push-pull seduction through space and timing, no lounge jazz, elevator music or huge percussion.
